# tile24 item 1 (vitaGL 0057 vglTexMakeTiledTarget, default off, console-only: the host does not model tiling). Pass targets and EFB-copy textures (RGBA8, 32+ texels each way) become SCE_GXM_COLOR_SURFACE_TILED with tiled textures; the EFB and the display stay linear. PASS if the picture is unchanged (any garbage, shear or black pass is a layout rule broken: stop and report which scene) and the [vgx] line says N tiled render-target textures; the gain is [lane] gpu ms in held scenes (walk-out, celebration, replay: about 15 scenes a picture) and in play. A crash at the first pass is also a result.
